healing_spring.name: Healing Spring
healing_spring.description: Clear water bubbles up from a quiet stone basin.

choices.label: Drink
choices.description: Heal 20% of your maximum HP.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Continue without drinking.

golden_idol.name: Golden Idol
golden_idol.description: A valuable idol rests behind a line of sharpened stones.

choices.label: Take the Idol
choices.description: Lose 7 HP. Gain 100 gold.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Avoid the trap.

potion_lab.name: Abandoned Laboratory
potion_lab.description: One intact potion remains among the broken glass.

choices.label: Search the Shelves
choices.description: Gain a random potion. Gain 30 gold instead if your slots are full.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Do not disturb the laboratory.

the_cleric.name: The Cleric
the_cleric.description: A man in strange garb offers you his services.

choices.label: Heal
choices.description: Heal 25% of your Max HP. Lose 35 Gold.

choices.label: Purify
choices.description: Remove a random Strike or Defend from your deck. Lose 50 Gold.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Leave the Cleric.

scrap_ooze.name: Scrap Ooze
scrap_ooze.description: A pile of metallic sludge holds a shiny object. Reaching in will hurt.

choices.label: Reach Inside
choices.description: Take 10 damage to gain a random Relic.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Leave it alone.

vampires.name: Vampires(?)
vampires.description: A group of hooded figures offer you a cup of dark blood.

choices.label: Accept
choices.description: Lose 30% Max HP. Replace all Strikes with Bites.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.description: Politely decline.

mysterious_sphere.name: Mysterious Sphere
mysterious_sphere.description: A humming metal sphere splits open along a seam. Something glints inside.

choices.label: Reach Inside
choices.description: Take 10 damage to gain a random Relic.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Back away slowly.

fountain_of_purity.name: Fountain of Purity
fountain_of_purity.description: A crystalline fountain pours endlessly into a basin of light.

choices.label: Drink Deeply
choices.description: Heal 30% of your maximum HP.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Continue on your way.

wandering_merchant.name: Wandering Merchant
wandering_merchant.description: A cloaked figure sets down a heavy pack and offers a few odd services.

choices.label: Field Medicine
choices.description: Heal 25% of your Max HP. Lose 40 Gold.

choices.label: Rummage the Pack
choices.description: Gain a random potion. Gain 25 gold instead if your slots are full.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Decline and move on.

bonfire_spirits.name: Bonfire Spirits
bonfire_spirits.description: Playful spirits dance around a roaring bonfire, beckoning for an offering.

choices.label: Offer a Basic Card
choices.description: Remove a random Strike or Defend from your deck.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Warm your hands and move on.

forgotten_cache.name: Forgotten Cache
forgotten_cache.description: A cracked lockbox sits half-buried beneath old battlefield ash.

choices.label: Force It Open
choices.description: Lose 6 HP. Gain 80 gold.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Leave the lockbox untouched.

field_surgeon.name: Field Surgeon
field_surgeon.description: A tired medic offers quick treatment before the road turns dangerous.

choices.label: Patch Up
choices.description: Heal 20% of your Max HP. Lose 25 Gold.

choices.label: Cleanse Supplies
choices.description: Remove a random Strike or Defend from your deck. Lose 60 Gold.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: Thank the medic and move on.

sealed_chest.name: Sealed Chest
sealed_chest.description: A heavy chest hums with pressure whenever you touch the latch.

choices.label: Open It
choices.description: Take 12 damage to gain a random Relic.

choices.label: Leave
choices.description: The chest can keep its secret.
